mapper.insert: insert into t_idem_record (enterprise_id, user_id, request_id, api, status, create_time) values (#{enterpriseId}, #{userId}, #{requestId}, #{api}, '0', sysdate())
mapper.select: select idem_id as idemId, enterprise_id as enterpriseId, user_id as userId, request_id as requestId, api as api, status as status, result_summary as resultSummary, create_time as createTime from t_idem_record where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.update: update t_idem_record set status = #{status}, result_summary = #{resultSummary} where idem_id = #{idemId}
update t_idem_record set status = '0' where idem_id = #{idemId}
